meta.name: gpt-image
meta.description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, mask-based editing, multi-image reference, batch generation. Use for: product mockups, marketing visuals, image editing, concept art, inpainting, photo manipulation. Triggers: gpt image, gpt-image-2, openai image, chatgpt image, dall-e, dalle, openai image generation, gpt image edit, gpt inpainting, openai dall-e, gpt 4o image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或修改产品图、营销素材等图片。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or edit product images, marketing visuals, etc.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过命令行调用 OpenAI GPT-Image-2 模型来生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、图编辑、局部重绘、多图参考和批量生成。
howto.when: 当用户提到“gpt image”、“dall-e”、“openai image”等关键词，或要求生成、编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张猫宇航员在太空中的图片。
say.note: Claude 会调用 GPT-Image-2 生成图片。

say.text: 把这张照片的背景换成海滩日落。
say.note: 需要提供参考图片链接，Claude 会进行图编辑。

say.text: 生成4个咖啡店极简logo方案。
say.note: Claude 会批量生成4张图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate and edit images using OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via CLI, supporting text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, multi-image reference, and batch generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "gpt image", "dall-e", "openai image", or asks to generate or edit images.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut floating in space.
say_en.note: Claude will call GPT-Image-2 to generate the image.

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to a beach sunset.
say_en.note: Requires a reference image URL; Claude will edit the image.

say_en.text: Generate 4 minimalist logo designs for a coffee shop.
